attempted_axis: EXTERN-RETYPE lane (work_claim.extern-retype.20260901.v1), eight defake-gated batches across seven TUs: replace each shadowing untyped extern (`extern u8 X[]` / `extern u8* X` / `extern void* X`) with the project header's real type, casting the base at every arithmetic site instead of respelling the addends; then census the prototype half of the widened externcheck table at REGISTER level and correct the one row that proved to be our own reconstruction error.

attributes.law_screen: claim.law.untyped-extern-retype-is-neutral-and-unblocking.20260831.v1 APPLIED as the whole method and CONFIRMED again on 7 more TUs: all four of its operational rules held. Rule (1) form-preserve-at-every-site (cast the BASE `(u8*)X + expr`, never respell the addend) was used at all 62 sites and every batch gated byte-identical. Rule (2) 'the compiler finds the sites for you' held and paid off twice beyond globals: adding game/item.h to player.c surfaced TWO wrong function prototypes (PlaceItem, AddItem) that no grep would have found. Rule (3) strides stay bare: every 0x335C/0x394/0xAE0/0xF0/240/13148/2784/916 literal was left as a literal (claim.law.sizeof-defeats-loop-stride-induction SCREENED, not applied). Rule (4) symbol-identity screen passed for gPlayers/gEnemies/gCritterPool/gWorldInfo/sItems/Effects: each header struct size equals the TU's own walked stride exactly (Player 0x335C, Enemy 0x394, Critter 0xAE0, Item 0xF0, Effect 0xF0, WorldInfo 0xA4). claim.law.lwzu-idiom-web-retention SCREENED and honoured: pmotion.c's two `fxRecord += 0x14` / `effectRecord += 0x14` load-update idioms sit on TU-local u8* webs, so the retype was done AROUND them (only the initialiser's base was cast) and both functions stayed byte-identical. claim.law.float-width-prototype-split-is-often-the-shipped-per-tu-shim.20260901.v1 APPLIED as a DO-NOT-TOUCH screen: every same-arity f32/f64 prototype row surfaced by the register census (mbBlitCvtCoord x7, MBPsysSetERate4 x3, MBPsysSetPSpeed x3, Random, sin) was left alone on its authority. claim.law.knr-extern-arity-can-be-faithful-not-a-defect.20260831.v1 APPLIED: 37 zero-arity passthrough rows excluded from the defect set by construction. claim.law.int-vs-signed-long-extern-reorders-schedule.20260831.v1 SCREENED: no HAZARD-class int/s32 row was touched in any lane TU. claim.HW_externcheck-defect-table-worked-state.20260901.v1 SCREENED: its group-(A) strike list was honoured -- gWinGlobals (5 disagreeing EXACT TUs) was left alone everywhere it appears in this lane's ranking, and lbl_80344EE8 / gSceneRoot / lbl_80344EA8-EBC were left raw for the same many-disagreeing-sides reason. claim.law.own-pool-ghost-extern-flatters-fndiff-reloc-rows.20260831.v1 SCREENED: no own-pool lbl_<ADDR> declaration was converted, so no score-flattering reloc row was disturbed. claim.law.cross-tu-extern-conflict-benign-self-consistent-scaling.20260830.v1 SCREENED: gFloorCollisionResult and gCameras were left alone as already-screened benign.
